meaning: Training validity depends on representative spaces and equipment

proposed_owner: Facility delivery lead and both training leads
proposed_evidence: Availability/representativeness map; procedure/configuration identity; Stage B observations

proposed_meaning: Airline and operator exchange acknowledged custody, status, service restriction, escalation and restart information with agreed decision rights; preserve unresolved conflicts.
proposed_owner: Airline duty manager and terminal duty manager jointly
proposed_evidence: HG-10-SC01 to SC03 handover records and joint restriction/recovery decisions

proposed_meaning: Front-line concerns receive a traceable acknowledgement, impact assessment, owner, disposition and reopening trigger; unresolved concerns remain visible to readiness authority.
proposed_owner: Joint readiness chair with front-line representatives
proposed_evidence: Concern/issue log; HG-10-SC03 escalation; disposition and follow-up evidence

meaning: Demonstrated staff performance supports the readiness claim

proposed_evidence: Staff-role/configuration record; actual/simulated step distinction; observations and issue dispositions
